fusions.name: Worked Appetite
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 4 damage, rising by 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (up to 30%), and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Bolted Meal
fusions.desc: Bolts up to 6 tiles to the target and bites for 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Nosebag Round
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles. You move 15% faster for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Earned Fodder
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
